tabs.title: Scenario
tabs.content:
**Solaris Education Platform** is an EdTech startup that provides on-demand video lessons to students worldwide. They are leveraging Azure to ensure high availability and global reach. 

**Current Architecture:**
- Primary web application runs on Azure App Service.
- Video files are stored in Azure Blob Storage.
- A legacy Windows-based accounting software runs on an Azure Virtual Machine.
- They use Azure SQL Database for user profiles and course progress data.

tabs.title: Goals
tabs.content:
**Future Plans:**
- Implement a serverless processing engine that triggers whenever a new video is uploaded to storage.
- Move the legacy accounting software to a more cost-effective model that doesn't require managing a full OS.
- Provide a centralized dashboard to monitor the health of all Azure services.
